pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with jagged, multi-lobed boundaries. Pixel gradients at patch edges are significantly sharper on the upper neck than on the posterior flank, where they appear more diffuse. Patch spatial area decreases from the dorsal neck toward the ventral and posterior regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Highly connected network of light pelage forming irregular junction nodes connecting 3 to 4 pathways. Corridor thickness is variable, exhibiting greater pixel width on the mid-flank compared to the narrow, more constrained pathways between neck patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A continuous, high-frequency serrated silhouette is visible along the dorsal neck, with low-amplitude hair clusters creating a jagged contour against the background.
